intro.title: Discover your relationship with technology
intro.disclaimer: A reflection of your relationship with technology, not a diagnosis or medical advice.

frame.reporterQuestion: Before we start, who is this for?
frame.identityQuestion: Where can we send your result?
frame.lifeStageQuestion: What's your current stage of life?

baseline.question:
No judgment or overthinking.

In the past month, what's your relationship with your phone, screens, and other technology?

options.label: I'm in control of my screens. They serve me.
Mostly fine, I just get pulled in more than I'd like.
I use it more than I really want to.
It often feels hard to stop, even when I try.
It's totally taken over my life.

pull.platformQuestion: Pick up to 3 platforms that draw you in the most.
pull.platformHint: The ones you reach for without thinking.
pull.subfeatureQuestion: Which features are the hardest to stop, or cause the most problems?

loop.entryQuestion: When do you usually get pulled in the most?

entryOptions.label: Late at night, especially in bed
First thing when I wake up
Fill the downtime throughout the day like waiting, commuting, bathroom breaks, or time between meetings and classes.
Before I start something hard like work, school, or a task
After I'm drained, overwhelmed, stressed, or upset
When I'm alone or feel disconnected
When I'm bored, restless, or under-stimulated
Honestly, it doesn't really get away from me

loop.patternQuestion: What does your usage look like?

patternOptions.label: I quickly check throughout the day.
I only mean to use it for a little while, but I end up staying way longer than I planned.
Sometimes I open it without meaning to. My hand just goes there.
I keep coming back to see if something changed (a new reply, like, view, update, score, or notification).
I keep going because I feel like I need to finish, clear, find, or complete something.
I leave it on in the background while I'm doing other things.
I get pulled in because I'm actively chatting, replying, posting, gaming, or keeping up with people.

loop.controlQuestion:
"I keep using it even though part of me wants to stop."

Lately, how often does this describe you?
loop.severityQuestion: In the last month, which of these have been true?

severityOptions.label: I keep going even after part of me wants to stop.
I tried to cut down and couldn't.
I tell myself "just a little," but it keeps turning into more.
I feel restless, anxious, irritated, or off when I can't use it.
I keep thinking about it even when I'm doing something else.
I sometimes hide, downplay, or make it sound like less than it is.
Sometimes it gets in the way of my sleep, work, school, mood, money, body, or relationships.
It doesn't even feel good anymore, but it still helps when I'm stressed, bored, lonely, or restless.

cost.aftertasteQuestion: After you've used these applications, how do you usually feel?

aftertasteOptions.label: Worse about myself or my body

cost.costQuestion: Where has it impacted your life?

costOptions.label: How I feel about myself or my body
Conflict at home or with family

disambiguation.prompt: Two patterns came up close. Which one feels more true?

result.missedQuestion: If none quite fit, or we got something wrong, tell us what we missed about how you actually use tech.
